title: Authority and segregation of duties
ambiguity: Preparer limits, reviewer authority and partner firm/engagement authority need explicit assignment, admin and billing permission rules.
approvedBy: User delegated implementation decisions to Codex
approvalEvidence: User: ignore it, you approve it. Professional certification and live provider acceptance remain separate.
implementationDefault: Store PREPARER/REVIEWER/APPROVER/BILLING/ADMIN per engagement Membership. Effective authority requires an active internal User, exact membership tuple, membership-role capability ceiling, current scoped RoleGrant and owning command state/version guards. Keep CLIENT on the separate PortalUser boundary. ADMIN cannot be promoted to business authority; BILLING alone receives Practice capabilities; partner approvals require APPROVER plus an explicit scoped grant. RoleGrant records grantor, expiry, reason and revocation. Engagement team assignment/revocation requires an APPROVER membership plus a current engagement-scoped TEAM_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGE grant, an active target identity, role-ceiling-checked capabilities, a future expiry and a reason; self-change is denied and writes are audited/idempotent. Fine-grained workprogram assignment and final bundle release await T091/T106 and T129/T130 domain models.

title: How .xlsx workbooks reach the Trial Balance import (DN-01)
ambiguity: Staff uploads are ClamAV-screened (T033) and accept PDF and CSV only, so a workbook had no screened route into the import.
approvedBy: Repository owner, in the chat decision for DN-01 (2026-10-08)
approvalEvidence: Owner answer to DN-01: "A: extend the screened upload (Recommended)".
implementationDefault: Accept .xlsx only through the ClamAV-screened staff upload session (T033) in the Trial Balance category. Run the same ZIP preflight (encryption, macro parts, unsafe names, bounded inflation) before storage. Import a stored workbook version through the same durable import pipeline as CSV. Never accept workbooks through an unscreened JSON or multipart route.

title: Cached formula values in workbooks (DN-02)
ambiguity: Accounting exports often contain formula totals. Rejecting every formula cell refused them outright.
approvedBy: Repository owner, in the chat decision for DN-02 (2026-10-08)
approvalEvidence: Owner answer to DN-02: "B: accept cached value, record formula (Recommended)".
implementationDefault: Accept the cached result of a workbook formula cell and keep its formula text in the row raw values. Never evaluate a formula. Refuse a formula cell that has no usable cached result, with its source line. Errors and non-numeric cached results are refused.

title: Formula-like text in exported CSV and XLSX (DN-03)
ambiguity: Cells beginning with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return can be evaluated by spreadsheet software when an export is opened. Numeric amounts also begin with a minus sign and must not change.
approvedBy: Repository owner, in the chat decision for DN-03 (2026-10-08)
approvalEvidence: Owner answer to DN-03: "A: prefix text cells with an apostrophe (Recommended)".
implementationDefault: On export, prefix a text cell that begins with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return with an apostrophe. Never alter amount or count cells. Each exporter names its amount columns explicitly.

title: Trial Balance validation policies (DN-04)
ambiguity: No required-account list existed. The statutory period was accepted on engagement creation but never stored, and duplicate engagements were judged by name alone. The owner also had to say which findings block finalization.
approvedBy: Repository owner, in the chat decision for DN-04 (2026-10-08)
approvalEvidence: Owner answers to DN-04: no required-account list; period from engagement, mismatch blocks; duplicates refused; only balance and mapping failures block.
implementationDefault: No required-account list. The statutory period is stored on the engagement and snapshotted on each Trial Balance import when it is staged; finalization refuses a missing period and any period that differs from the snapshot. A duplicate engagement is one with the same client, name and period. Duplicate account codes in a file are refused. Only unbalanced periods and unmapped accounts block finalization.

approvalEvidence: Owner answer to DN-05: "A: client-scoped only (Recommended)".
implementationDefault: Mapping memory is client-scoped only. Firm-wide suggestions are not offered until a firm approval exists for them. Every suggestion names its source approval.

title: Supersession of finalized Trial Balance versions (DN-06)

approvedBy: Repository owner, in the chat decision for DN-06 (2026-10-08)
approvalEvidence: Owner answer to DN-06: "A: one active version; supersede explicitly (Recommended)".
implementationDefault: At most one active finalized Trial Balance version per engagement. A new version is finalized only after an explicit supersede command names the earlier version, invalidates the approvals that cite it, and is audited.

title: Materiality benchmarks and normalized profit before tax (DN-07)
sourceLines: docs/requirements/CURRENT.md 4.2.4 and 3.2; docs/02-decisions-needed.md DN-07; T085; T086
ambiguity: The code offered two benchmarks outside the specification, its ranges differed from CURRENT, the manager rounding rule was absent, and profit before tax was not normalized.
approvedBy: Repository owner, in the chat decision for DN-07 (2026-10-08)
approvalEvidence: Owner answer to DN-07: "Remove extras; PBT adjustments as recorded inputs (Recommended)".
implementationDefault: Only the four CURRENT benchmarks are offered, with CURRENT ranges (PBT 5-10 %, revenue 0.5-2 %, total assets 0.5-1 %, equity or net assets 1-2 %, TE 50-75 % of PM, SAD 3-5 % of PM). Normalized PBT is the tax-excluded PBT plus recorded, approved adjustments supplied to the pure calculator. Manager rounding of PM is limited to plus or minus 5 %.
